text:
deploy-bot: Deployed model redwood-2026-03.1 to prod-us-west at 2026-03-12T22:34Z (release 2026-03.1-rc7)

Aaron P. (CSE): FYI customers NimbusHealth and LedgerCorp flagged behavior changes post-deploy. Nimbus says clinical guidance answers are now shorter and include an extra hedging sentence. LedgerCorp reports additional policy-style refusals for previously allowed queries.

Nora L. (Product): Do we have a single root cause (checkpoint swap vs safety policy change)?

Priya S. (Eng): Release touched both: new checkpoint redwood-2026-03.1 and an updated safety pipeline (safety-filter v2026-03-11). Our internal logs show increased trigger rates for the classifier on the clinical prompts.

Ethan Q. (oncall): Immediate mitigations we can offer to customers:
- Pin to last known-good model: redwood-2026-02-stable
- Use header override: X-Model: redwood-2026-02-stable
- Apply transient workspace-level safety override via admin API (requires tenant consent)

Aaron P. (CSE): Customers want a one-paragraph note and repro checklist we can paste in their ticket. Also asking about any billing implications if they replay requests.

support-bot: Note: we observed a small spike in 429 retries from some customers after the deploy (03:00-03:40 UTC) — correlated with automated replay tools.

billing-bot: Alert: two tenants recorded unusual request volume and retry-related increases; recommend advising customers to pause bulk replays until we confirm.

Nora L. (Product): Draft customer-facing message (please edit):"We rolled an updated model and safety filter yesterday which tightened some responses for particular prompts. We're investigating and can pin your workspace back to the previous model immediately if you prefer. To help us diagnose, please attach one example prompt/response and the x-request-id header. We'll prioritize affected customers and aim to restore previous behavior within 1-2 hours of confirmation."

Aaron P. (CSE): I'll send that but include the pin curl snippet.

Priya S. (Eng): Pin curl example for customers (public API):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY\" \
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \
  -d '{\"model\":\"redwood-2026-02-stable\",\"input\":\"<your prompt>\"}'
```

Ethan Q. (oncall): For customers on Dedicated we can do a tenant-scoped routing change from the console. For Hosted workspaces we can set a scoped safety override via the admin API:
```
# admin-api: lower safety level for tenant (one-time transient)
POST https://admin.redwood.ai/v1/tenants/{tenant_id}/overrides
Body: {\"safety_override\": \"lenient\", \"expires_in\": 3600}
```

Aaron P. (CSE): Also collecting repro info checklist for tickets:
1) Minimal prompt that produced the changed output
2) Full API response body (including any refusal text)
3) x-request-id header
4) workspace/tenant id and region
5) Approx timestamp (UTC)

Priya S. (Eng): Internal repro steps: took a sample clinical prompt that earlier returned an explicit treatment recommendation; with safety-filter v2026-03-11 it returns a short refusal + link to docs. The classifier marginal score increased ~0.23 vs baseline, pushing into the refusal path. There's also a postprocesser that shortens replies after a refusal tag.

Ethan Q. (oncall): Quick runtime interventions we've done / can do:
- Scoped revert of safety-config to v2026-03-09 for affected region (done for prod-us-west)
- Tenant-scoped safety_override for high-urgency customers (manual)
- Model pinning on request header

deploy-bot: Applied config change: safety-filter rolled back to v2026-03-09 in prod-us-west at 2026-03-12T23:05Z (scoped override).

Aaron P. (CSE): NimbusHealth accepted the pin and confirms reply tone is restored. LedgerCorp wants a short SLA-style acknowledgement before we change their tenant config; asking for a written mitigation note.

Nora L. (Product): Writeup for LedgerCorp (SLA-friendly):"We acknowledge the change in response behavior you observed after our recent release. We have scoped a temporary mitigation option (model pin or tenant-level safety override). If you approve, we will apply the mitigation within 30 minutes and monitor for 2 hours, then revert per your instruction. We will follow up with a post-release analysis and a permanent fix timeline."

billing-bot: Reminder: if customers replay large sets after pinning, they may incur duplicate billing for successful calls. Recommend caution and suggest sampling first.

Ethan Q. (oncall): Monitoring notes and timeline:
- 22:34 UTC: Deploy complete
- 22:45 UTC: First customer reports
- 23:05 UTC: Scoped safety-config revert applied in prod-us-west
- 23:20 UTC: NimbusHealth confirms improvement after pin
- 23:40 UTC: LedgerCorp requests SLA note before change

Priya S. (Eng): Action items for Eng:
- Add a gating eval for \"policy-adjacent clinical Qs\" to detect answer-length/abstain rate deltas
- Instrument classifier score distribution metrics in prod dashboards
- Roll forward a patched safety-transform that preserves answer length on borderline decisions

Nora L. (Product): I'll schedule a 20-min post-incident sync at 08:00 UTC tomorrow to review root cause and permanent remediation. Aaron, please attach customer quotes to the ticket thread.

Aaron P. (CSE): Will do. Sending repro checklist + the pin curl to affected customers now and pausing any mass replays. Will update here if more examples arrive. :white_check_mark:

Participants: deploy-bot, Aaron P. (CSE), Nora L. (Product), Ethan Q. (oncall), Priya S. (Eng), billing-bot, support-bot
